G1_unambiguity.justification: The connectivity, tree structure, critical-edge definition, validity condition, and objective together specify a single clear interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: All necessary constraints, input formats, structural guarantees, costs, and edge cases are stated, including the single-key-holder case.

G3_faithfulness.justification: In a positively weighted tree, the critical agreements are exactly the edges required to connect all key corporations, so minimizing a valid subset yields exactly the original minimum connecting-subtree cost.

G4_naturalness.justification: The corporate and regulatory framing is coherent and readable, though it is somewhat more elaborate than necessary for the underlying graph problem.
